messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up  onsite candidate next Wed (Jun 12) needs ASL interpreter and access to a lactation room post-interview. Can facilities/security/cafe help coordinate? :pray:

Lila Gomez: Thanks Priya. Candidate: Mateo Rivera, +1-415-555-0210. ETA 10:20am by BART. Interview panel starts 10:45. ASL interpreter requested in-person 10:40-11:20. Lactation room needed around 12:00 for ~20m. Any dietary or scent preferences?

Priya Menon: Mateo prefers low-fragrance spaces. No dietary restrictions noted but prefers vegetarian. We'll offer a boxed meal. Please confirm interpreter booking and an on-site lactation room keyed for privacy.

Facilities Bot: Lactation Room A (2nd floor) reserved 11:5012:30. Door will be set to privacy mode and a temporary access badge issued for "Mateo Rivera" valid 11:5012:35. Room amenities: chair, table, small fridge, white noise machine. Hand sanitizer provided.

Security Desk: Visitor badge printed under "Mateo Rivera". ID required at check-in. Staff at desk will SMS the People Ops lead when badge is picked up. BART shuttle directions: recommend elevator at Entrance 2 for step-free access.

Wellness Concierge: ASL interpreter (in-person) booked: Daniela Cruz 10:4011:20. Daniela will meet candidate at Quiet Room D and join the panel via in-room mic. Backup remote interpreter booked (VRI) if needed.

Cafe Team: Vegetarian boxed lunch (quinoa salad + roasted veg) ordered, low-fragrance packaging, deliver at 11:10 to Quiet Room D. If Mateo prefers dairy-free, we'll swap to lentil bowl.

Lila Gomez: Run-of-day (short):
```
10:20  Candidate arrives / badge check (Security Desk)
10:35  Quiet Room D prep + interpreter arrives
10:45  Panel interviews start (2x35m with 10m break)
11:40  Wrap + quick debrief
11:50  Lactation room access (20m)
12:15  Candidate leaves / People Ops debrief
```
Zoom fallback (in case of transit delay): https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback

Priya Menon: Can Security SMS me when Mateo picks up the badge and again when he heads upstairs? Also please confirm lactation badge is single-use.

Security Desk: Will SMS Priya at pickup and at escort to 2nd floor. Lactation badge is single-use and will be deactivated after 12:35.

Facilities Bot: We'll place a small low-light lamp in Quiet Room D and set white noise machine level to 2. Lactation Room A will have a spare phone charger and a seating cushion.

Lila Gomez: Thanks everyone. I'll DM Mateo the calendar invite, Zoom fallback, step-free directions, and an access note about the lactation room. Tagging @Facilities Bot @Security Desk @Cafe Team @Wellness Concierge :heart:
